selection.ownership: AddressZen is the international address autocomplete/verification API operated with Ideal Postcodes (IDDQD Limited, United Kingdom; founder Christopher Blanchard). The reviewed edition is the public HTTPS API at api.addresszen.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official AddressZen REST API v1 (api_key query authentication, GET /v1/keys/{key} availability, GET /v1/autocomplete/addresses, GET /v1/autocomplete/addresses/{address}/usa), error handling (non-200 HTTP status), autocomplete vs paid retrieve, ISO 27001, UK Ideal Postcodes/IDDQD identity, and dated incident search for AddressZen / Ideal Postcodes security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. The 2025 High Court GetAddress.io matter is IP/database-rights litigation, not a customer-data compromise. No qualifying current unresolved customer-data compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official AddressZen v1 at https://api.addresszen.com with api_key query auth and GET /v1/keys/{key} availability probe reviewed on 2026-09-13. Operator is the UK Ideal Postcodes/IDDQD AddressZen edition. Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved customer-data compromise. The 2025 GetAddress.io High Court case is IP litigation.

incidents.finding: Ideal Postcodes/IDDQD won a High Court database-rights case against GetAddress.io. This is IP litigation, not an AddressZen customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /v1/keys/{key} used by the pinned validator. This is a key-availability read, not a billed address retrieve.
Native also sends the global api_key query parameter used by most AddressZen routes; the pinned keys helper omits that query and puts the key only in the path.
Returns raw AddressZen JSON under data. The upstream user-agent is not sent.

Maps to official GET /v1/autocomplete/addresses. Official authentication examples use query name q; pinned source sent query. Native binds input query to wire q. Official 150-character query cap is not expressed as JSON Schema maxLength because strict-generated schemas reject that keyword.
Optional context, country, and limit (1–100) match the pinned action. Official docs: autocomplete does not decrement balance; retrieve does.
Maps to official GET /v1/autocomplete/addresses/{address}/usa. address is a required URL-encoded path segment. This is the billed retrieve step.
Maps to official POST /v1/verify/addresses. Native binds zipCode to zip_code.
Maps to official GET /v1/places. Native sends the documented query parameter name.
Maps to official GET /v1/phone_numbers. Native binds currentCarrier to current_carrier.
Maps to official GET /v1/keys/{key}/details. Path key is the stored apiKey.
Maps to official PUT /v1/keys/{key}/details with a name-only body.
Maps to official GET /v1/keys/{key}/licensees. Native binds startingAfter to starting_after.
